title: Context-pack path escape guard

summary.behavior: Context packing now resolves candidate paths and walks every parent to the repository root before writing. Reparse points, non-directory parents, drive roots outside the repository, and non-NotFound inspection failures fail closed instead of being treated as safe repository paths. Six offline synthetic cases cover accepted in-root paths and the rejection classes including inspection failure.

validation.notes: 12 glob cases plus 6 path-guard cases passed; offline/no-file-write
ownership, scope and Git state verified on delivered branch

scope: tools-only context-pack hardening; no product/API/schema/DSP/driver change; no live audio probe performed; no identity-bearing output introduced
